list.description: Prometheus scraping the TON node metrics exporters
list.label: Prometheus
list.name: datasource
trust
list.label: QUIC peer class
list.description: Filters peer-attributable QUIC app, query, delivery, and ready-connection metrics. The wire/app overhead ratio remains all-peers so its app denominator matches the unsplit wire numerator. Socket/pre-auth QUIC and all ADNL, RLDP2, and overlay series also remain all-peers. Pre-trust builds expose no trust label: their QUIC series appear under All, but not under trusted or untrusted.

panels.title: UDP in (fleet)
panels.description: UDP payload bytes/s the sockets received, summed over ADNL and QUIC for all selected nodes. RLDP2 rides inside ADNL and is already counted there. Informational; no health threshold.

panels.title: UDP out (fleet)
panels.description: UDP payload bytes/s the kernel accepted for sending, summed over ADNL and QUIC for all selected nodes. Refused sends are drops, not wire traffic. Informational; no health threshold.

panels.title: QUIC query RTT p95
panels.description: Outbound QUIC query roundtrip p95 for the selected peer class, computed from histogram buckets summed across the fleet. Includes network path, peer processing, and transfer time. Yellow at 0.5 s; red at 2 s.

panels.title: QUIC query fail %
panels.description: Outbound QUIC query failures divided by measured roundtrips for the selected peer class across the fleet. Green below 1%, yellow at 1%, red at 5%. No data means no completed QUIC queries in the interval; it is not presented as a healthy 0%.

panels.title: QUIC packet loss %
panels.description: QUIC packets declared lost divided by outbound packets across the fleet. Most loss is recovered, but it costs bandwidth and tail latency. Yellow at 1%; red at 5%. No outbound packets in the current interval renders No data, not 0%.

panels.title: Kernel RX overflow
panels.description: ADNL + QUIC datagrams/s dropped because a socket receive buffer was full (SO_RXQ_OVFL). Sustained nonzero means ingress outruns the reader; raise SO_RCVBUF or add read capacity, then inspect the by-node panel. Linux-only: macOS/local nets report structural zero, meaning no signal rather than proof of no drops.

panels.title: Outbound query RTT p95 by transport
panels.description: Transport-accept to answer for queries we send: network + peer processing + transfer time. QUIC is split by peer class; ADNL remains all-peers. p95 comes from fleet-summed histogram buckets. RLDP2 bulk-transfer latency is separate below because it is not comparable with low-latency ADNL/QUIC.

panels.title: Inbound query processing p95 by type
panels.description: Time this node spends answering inbound queries, excluding network transfer. All transports funnel through this ADNL delivery-layer timer. Histogram buckets are summed across the fleet; the top 8 types are ranked by call volume over the visible range.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (tl, le) (rate(ton_adnl_query_duration_seconds_bucket{ton_scope=~"$scope",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (tl) topk(8, sum by (tl) (increase(ton_adnl_query_duration_seconds_count{ton_scope=~"$scope",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__range] @ end())))

panels.title: Message delivery p95
panels.description: QUIC fire-and-forget delivery p95 to the receiver's empty acknowledgement, split by peer class and computed from fleet-summed histogram buckets. Plain ADNL has no acknowledgement. RLDP2 transfer delivery is separate below because bulk-transfer latency is not comparable.

panels.title: Failure & loss ratios
panels.description: Failures divided by measured deliveries, roundtrips, or packets across the fleet. Idle series disappear rather than presenting 0/0 as healthy. QUIC app outcomes are split by peer class; packet loss, ADNL, and RLDP2 remain all-peers. Persistent values above 1% deserve investigation.

panels.title: Network drops by tier and reason
panels.description: Nonzero drop rates by tier, direction, and reason across the fleet. The peer-class filter applies only to QUIC app drops; wire, pre-auth transport, ADNL, and RLDP2 remain all-peers. QUIC app out/limited indicates stream-credit exhaustion.

panels.title: QUIC RTT across nodes (p50 / p95 / max)
panels.description: Distribution over nodes of ton_quic_transport_mean_rtt_seconds — each node contributes one value: the connection-weighted mean smoothed RTT (ngtcp2 SRTT) over its open connections. p50 = the typical node, max = the worst node. This is network path RTT; peer processing time is excluded (compare the roundtrip row, which includes it).

panels.title: Kernel RX overflow by node/transport
panels.description: SO_RXQ_OVFL by node and transport: datagrams dropped before userspace could read them. Only nonzero series render. Sustained drops call for more receive-buffer or reader capacity. Linux-only: macOS/local nets report structural zero, meaning no signal rather than proof of no drops.

panels.title: Mean RTT by node
panels.description: Each node's connection-weighted mean smoothed RTT. A node whose line sits far above the rest peers across a long path or has a saturated uplink; a sudden step usually means its peer set changed.

panels.title: Inbound query failure ratio by type
panels.description: Inbound query failure share by type at the common delivery layer: explicit errors and dropped answer promises over completed-query observations. All transports funnel through this layer; types below 0.1 q/s fleet-wide are hidden. High dht.* failure is usually expected client-mode rejection unless --dht-server is enabled.

panels.title: Outbound roundtrip failure ratio by type
panels.description: Outbound query failure share by type and transport across the fleet; series below 0.1 q/s are hidden. QUIC is split by peer class; ADNL and RLDP2 remain all-peers.

panels.title: Open and ready QUIC connections
panels.description: Installed QUIC connections include handshakes and remain all-peers; ready paths are authenticated and split by direction and peer class. Installed and ready overlap and must not be added. Fleet sum across selected nodes.

panels.title: New QUIC connections: attempts vs completions
panels.description: Connection installs versus completed/rejected QUIC handshakes, summed across selected nodes. The gap is handshakes that died without a verdict, usually idle timeouts dialing peers that never answered.

panels.title: Handshake completion / attempt
panels.description: Completion event rate divided by connection-attempt event rate, by dial direction over 15m. This is a laggy proxy, not a cohort success percentage, and can transiently exceed 100%. Abandoned handshakes have no terminal outcome; no attempts in the window renders No data.

panels.title: Open QUIC streams by node
panels.description: Currently open streams per node, both directions of initiation (each side capped at 4096 per connection). A plateau near the cap while sends start failing with app dropped{out,limited} is the stream-credit exhaustion signature.

panels.title: Wire throughput by transport
panels.description: UDP payload bytes/s from each transport's socket accounting, summed across selected nodes. ADNL and QUIC own sockets; RLDP2 rides inside ADNL and is already present in its socket total.

panels.title: App payload by transport
panels.description: Application payload bytes/s after protocol framing, summed across selected nodes. QUIC is split by peer class; ADNL and RLDP2 remain all-peers. ADNL includes RLDP2 datagrams, so ADNL + RLDP2 double-counts.

panels.title: Nodes by wire throughput (adnl+quic)
panels.description: Busiest nodes by available ADNL+QUIC UDP bytes (in+out). A target remains visible when either collector family is absent.

panels.title: Datagrams per syscall
panels.description: Wire packets per UDP send/receive syscall across the fleet. 1.0 means no batching; higher is cheaper per packet. A direction disappears when it has no syscalls instead of producing an undefined ratio.

panels.title: Wire / app bytes (overhead factor, log scale)
panels.description: Wire bytes per delivered payload byte across the fleet. QUIC compares its own tiers; ADNL stack replaces rldp2.messagePart transfer data with RLDP2-delivered payload; RLDP2 alone exposes FEC, retransmission, and failed-transfer overhead. Idle transports disappear. The peer-class filter does not apply because wire counters are all-peers. Log scale.

panels.title: App traffic by kind, count
panels.description: Messages, queries, and answers/s at each transport's app boundary, summed across selected nodes. QUIC is split by peer class; ADNL and RLDP2 remain all-peers. Query and answer rates should track; a growing gap means unanswered queries.

panels.title: App traffic by kind, bytes
panels.description: App payload bytes/s for the same events, summed across selected nodes. QUIC is split by peer class. Compare with counts for size per item: answers usually dominate bytes while queries dominate count on serving nodes.

panels.title: Top payload types, inbound
panels.description: Inbound app payload bytes/s by resolved TL constructor. QUIC is split by peer class; ADNL remains all-peers. Routing envelopes are unwrapped. Fleet sum; rank-stable top 6 per transport.

targets.expr: sum by (trust, tl) (rate(ton_quic_app_bytes_total{direction="in",trust=~"$trust",ton_scope=~"$scope",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (tl) topk(6, sum by (tl) (increase(ton_quic_app_bytes_total{direction="in",trust=~"$trust",ton_scope=~"$scope",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__range] @ end())))

sum by (tl) (rate(ton_adnl_app_bytes_total{direction="in",ton_scope=~"$scope",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (tl) topk(6, sum by (tl) (increase(ton_adnl_app_bytes_total{direction="in",ton_scope=~"$scope",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__range] @ end())))

panels.title: Top payload types, outbound
panels.description: Outbound app payload bytes/s by resolved TL constructor. QUIC is split by peer class; ADNL remains all-peers. Broadcast FEC parts stay labeled as FEC constructors. Fleet sum; rank-stable top 6 per transport.

targets.expr: sum by (trust, tl) (rate(ton_quic_app_bytes_total{direction="out",trust=~"$trust",ton_scope=~"$scope",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (tl) topk(6, sum by (tl) (increase(ton_quic_app_bytes_total{direction="out",trust=~"$trust",ton_scope=~"$scope",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__range] @ end())))

sum by (tl) (rate(ton_adnl_app_bytes_total{direction="out",ton_scope=~"$scope",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (tl) topk(6, sum by (tl) (increase(ton_adnl_app_bytes_total{direction="out",ton_scope=~"$scope",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__range] @ end())))

panels.title: Top inbound QUIC queries by count
panels.description: Inbound QUIC queries/s by peer class and resolved TL constructor. The all-transport processing and failure panels remain above. Fleet sum; rank-stable top 10.

targets.expr: sum by (trust, tl) (rate(ton_quic_app_messages_total{kind="query",direction="in",trust=~"$trust",ton_scope=~"$scope",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (tl) topk(10, sum by (tl) (increase(ton_quic_app_messages_total{kind="query",direction="in",trust=~"$trust",ton_scope=~"$scope",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__range] @ end())))

panels.title: Top outbound queries by count
panels.description: Outbound queries/s by type and transport, derived from roundtrip histogram counts. QUIC is split by peer class; ADNL and RLDP2 remain all-peers. Fleet sum; rank-stable top 5 per transport.

targets.expr: sum by (trust, tl) (rate(ton_quic_query_roundtrip_seconds_count{trust=~"$trust",ton_scope=~"$scope",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (tl) topk(5, sum by (tl) (increase(ton_quic_query_roundtrip_seconds_count{trust=~"$trust",ton_scope=~"$scope",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__range] @ end())))

sum by (tl) (rate(ton_adnl_query_roundtrip_seconds_count{ton_scope=~"$scope",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (tl) topk(5, sum by (tl) (increase(ton_adnl_query_roundtrip_seconds_count{ton_scope=~"$scope",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__range] @ end())))

sum by (tl) (rate(ton_rldp2_query_roundtrip_seconds_count{ton_scope=~"$scope",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (tl) topk(5, sum by (tl) (increase(ton_rldp2_query_roundtrip_seconds_count{ton_scope=~"$scope",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__range] @ end())))

panels.title: Broadcast content by type, count
panels.description: Overlay broadcast content after FEC reassembly, summed across selected nodes and ranked as a stable top 6 per direction. Inbound includes a node's own broadcasts; outbound is counted pre-FEC at send entry points.

targets.expr: sum by (tl) (rate(ton_overlay_broadcast_messages_total{direction="in",ton_scope=~"$scope",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (tl) topk(6, sum by (tl) (increase(ton_overlay_broadcast_messages_total{direction="in",ton_scope=~"$scope",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__range] @ end())))

sum by (tl) (rate(ton_overlay_broadcast_messages_total{direction="out",ton_scope=~"$scope",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (tl) topk(6, sum by (tl) (increase(ton_overlay_broadcast_messages_total{direction="out",ton_scope=~"$scope",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__range] @ end())))

panels.title: Broadcast content by type, bytes
panels.description: Broadcast content bytes/s, not wire bytes. Transport FEC-part bytes minus this signal the redundancy and duplicate-reception tax. Fleet sum; rank-stable top 6 per direction; inbound includes a node's own broadcasts.

targets.expr: sum by (tl) (rate(ton_overlay_broadcast_bytes_total{direction="in",ton_scope=~"$scope",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (tl) topk(6, sum by (tl) (increase(ton_overlay_broadcast_bytes_total{direction="in",ton_scope=~"$scope",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__range] @ end())))

sum by (tl) (rate(ton_overlay_broadcast_bytes_total{direction="out",ton_scope=~"$scope",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (tl) topk(6, sum by (tl) (increase(ton_overlay_broadcast_bytes_total{direction="out",ton_scope=~"$scope",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__range] @ end())))

panels.title: RLDP2 latency p95
panels.description: Outbound RLDP2 query roundtrip and message-delivery p95 from fleet-summed histogram buckets. RLDP2 carries bulk transfers, so compare it separately from low-latency ADNL/QUIC. No data is normal when RLDP2 is idle. Delivery covers only sends carrying a timeout.

panels.title: RLDP2 wire activity
panels.description: RLDP2 datagrams/s exchanged with ADNL across the fleet. A flat zero proves the metric is present while bulk transfer is idle. Transfer outcomes use their own panel and scale above.

panels.title: RLDP2 transfer failures
panels.description: Failed and timed-out whole RLDP2 transfers as a share of all terminal outcomes, split by direction. Completed transfers/s stays visible on the right axis as activity context without flattening the failure signal. Yellow at 1%; red at 5%.

targets.expr: (sum by (direction, state) (rate(ton_rldp2_transport_transfers_total{state=~"failed|timeout",ton_scope=~"$scope",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) / on (direction) group_left sum by (direction) (rate(ton_rldp2_transport_transfers_total{ton_scope=~"$scope",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (direction) (sum by (direction) (rate(ton_rldp2_transport_transfers_total{ton_scope=~"$scope",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)
